method: Two fresh Chromium/profile rounds, Page-only subscriptions (no Runtime.enable/binding). Actual fixed guard local origin. 4scenarios per round,6open/close cycles,1000cards/200native checkbox activations each,optional24synthetic video previews. Trusted mouse input after each cycle. Headless macOS, not production collect/Rust/network or customer platform. RSS is summed own Chromium process IDs; JS GC before/after separate, no proof against native decode memory leak. Autoplay test-only.
